WHEN max(variants)>1 THEN raise_error('ASHLAR_OVERLAY_VERSION_CONFLICT') ELSE max_by(carrier,entity_version) END AS winner FROM (SELECT entity_version,count(DISTINCT sha2(concat(CASE WHEN source_system IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(source_system AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(source_system AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN rel_type_id IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(rel_type_id AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(rel_type_id AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN id IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(id AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(id AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN source_type IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(target_id AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(target_id AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN order_key IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(props_json AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(props_json AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN retained_json IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(retained_json AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(retained_json AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN source_feed IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(source_feed AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(source_feed AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN source_epoch IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(source_epoch AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(source_epoch AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN source_position IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(source_position AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(source_position AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN published_at IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(published_at AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(published_at AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN apply_batch_id IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(apply_batch_id AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(apply_batch_id AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN source_cursor_json IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(lookup_hash AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(lookup_hash AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN is_deleted IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(is_deleted AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(is_deleted AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END),256)) AS variants,first(named_struct('source_system',source_system,'rel_type_id',rel_type_id,'id',id,'source_type',source_type,'source_id',source_id,'target_type',target_type,'target_id',target_id,'order_key',order_key,'schema_revision',schema_revision,'entity_version',entity_version,'props_json',props_json,'retained_json',retained_json,'source_feed',source_feed,'source_epoch',source_epoch,'source_position',source_position,'published_at',published_at,'apply_batch_id',apply_batch_id,'source_cursor_json',source_cursor_json,'source_delivery_id',source_delivery_id,'lookup_hash',lookup_hash,'is_deleted',is_deleted))
